name: Koofr
tagline: Private, European GDPR-compliant cloud storage with WebDAV and Rclone support.

instructions.step1: Enter your Koofr account email address.
instructions.step2: Generate and enter an App-Specific Password from https://app.koofr.net/app/admin/preferences/password.
instructions.step3: Your virtual drive will mount immediately to ~/Koofr.

disclosure: Note: Koofr requires an App-Specific Password for Rclone connection. Your primary account login password will not work.

fields.label: Koofr Account Email
fields.helper: The email address associated with your Koofr account
